review.imagery: Root reviewed all332 source pages across eight fresh official PDFs, all69 qualifying master native resources and current own-page image candidates. Selected native concepts omit the accidental Acacia floor-image resource, repeated pixels, redundant crops and the joined detail collage. The AlJurf aerial is explicitly community-scoped. Own Canal Frame frontage is the card image. No generic nature, marina/yoga stock imagery or unrelated AlJurf Gardens construction photograph is delivered.
review.floorPlans: Root reviewed every delivered whole sheet and enlarged numerical schedules. All six named home collections and Main/West apartments remain distinct. Standalone Canal Strata333 ground differs from villa66pack261 and from534 sellable summary. Alghaf164/187 townhouse versus174/203 master measures remain separate. Main apartment level captions vary by pack. West five family schedules retain both currently linked editions. Published sellable, BUA and plots remain separate, with no invented conversion or per-Type area. Source tables retain component, unit and min/max errors. Whole paired floors, second levels, variations, labels and notices are preserved.
review.location: Root inspected the exact developer regional diagram, original community/master sheets and five brochure travel estimates. Fresh current phase HTML independently gives all six adopted destination minutes, including Yas25. No coordinates are published in reviewed phase HTML. Directions use the project name. Reem office and February2024 Gardens/Kayan photographs are excluded from home coordinates and Naseem construction evidence.
